listings.title: IFAD Grants Programme
listings.description: IFAD's regular grants programme supports inclusive rural transformation, capacity building and agricultural development. Eligibility depends on the grant instrument and eligible recipient type; applicants should use the current official IFAD information and calls for proposals.
listings.notes: Check current calls and eligibility before applying.
listings.seo_title: IFAD Agricultural Grants | GoOrganicAfrica
listings.seo_description: Official IFAD grants information for agricultural and rural development.

listings.title: IFAD Calls for Proposals
listings.description: Official IFAD call-for-proposals page listing current and recent grant opportunities, including country, regional and thematic calls. Closing dates and eligibility can change, so applicants should verify each call on IFAD before acting.
listings.notes: Use the current call page as the authoritative application source.
listings.seo_title: IFAD Calls for Proposals | GoOrganicAfrica
listings.seo_description: Find current official IFAD agricultural and rural development calls for proposals.

listings.title: Agri-Food SME Catalytic Financing Mechanism (ACFM)
listings.description: An African Development Bank special fund providing long-term concessional loans and grant-based technical assistance to catalyse private-sector investment in African agricultural SMEs.
listings.notes: Review eligibility and whether applications are direct or through participating mechanisms.
listings.seo_title: AfDB Agri-Food SME Catalytic Financing | GoOrganicAfrica
listings.seo_description: Official African Development Bank information on agricultural SME concessional finance and technical assistance.

listings.title: Africa Fertilizer Financing Mechanism
listings.description: An African Development Bank special fund providing financing solutions for fertilizer production, procurement and distribution and soil-health interventions across Africa.
listings.notes: This is primarily an institutional financing mechanism; not every farmer can apply directly.
listings.seo_title: Africa Fertilizer Financing Mechanism | GoOrganicAfrica
listings.seo_description: Official information on the Africa Fertilizer Financing Mechanism and agricultural input finance.

listings.title: GAFSP Financial Instruments
listings.description: The Global Agriculture and Food Security Program provides grants, blended concessional finance and related instruments for agricultural and food-security investments, including support through public and private sector windows.
listings.notes: Check the current programme and implementing entity for eligibility and access route.
listings.seo_title: GAFSP Agricultural Finance & Grants | GoOrganicAfrica
listings.seo_description: Official GAFSP financial instruments supporting agriculture and food security.

listings.title: IFAD Rural Finance
listings.description: IFAD's rural finance programme focuses on improving access to financial services for rural people, smallholder producers and rural MSMEs through inclusive financial solutions and risk-management approaches.
listings.notes: Use linked programme and country information to identify practical access routes.
listings.seo_title: IFAD Rural & Agricultural Finance | GoOrganicAfrica
listings.seo_description: Official IFAD information on rural finance and agricultural financial inclusion.

listings.title: FAO Africa Agricultural Mechanization Resources
listings.description: FAO's Africa mechanization resources cover sustainable mechanization approaches, financing, policy, skills, service models and equipment considerations for African farming systems.
listings.official_source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
listings.notes: Information resource; not a machinery seller. Use it to understand mechanization options and service models.
listings.seo_title: Agricultural Mechanization in Africa | GoOrganicAfrica
listings.seo_description: FAO resource on sustainable agricultural mechanization, equipment, financing and service models in Africa.

listings.title: Namibia Agricultural Mechanisation and Seed Improvement Project (NAMSIP)
listings.description: African Development Bank project information covering agricultural mechanisation, production and processing machinery, irrigation equipment, farmer cooperatives and training. The official project page describes the scope and implementation status.
listings.notes: Project/resource information, not a general machinery marketplace.
listings.seo_title: Namibia Agricultural Mechanisation Project | GoOrganicAfrica
listings.seo_description: Official AfDB information on Namibia's agricultural mechanisation and equipment project.

listings.title: FAO Machinery Supply Chain Resources
listings.category: Machinery supply, hire and repair services
listings.description: FAO guidance on agricultural machinery supply chains, including importers, manufacturers, retailers, machinery hire services, repair services, training, maintenance and farmer access to equipment services.
listings.official_source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
listings.notes: Information resource for finding and understanding machinery supply-chain and service models.
listings.seo_title: FAO Machinery Supply Chain Resources | GoOrganicAfrica
listings.seo_description: Official FAO resources on machinery suppliers, hire services, repair and agricultural mechanization.

listings.title: Agriculture and Food Security Project (GAFSP)
listings.category: Agricultural production, food security and market access
listings.description: AfDB reports a USD 16 million GAFSP-funded project managed with the Gambian government, covering climate-resilient production, post-harvest management, commercialization and market access across five regions.
listings.notes: Official institutional resource. Verify current eligibility, application route, programme status and closing dates before acting.

listings.seo_description: Official agricultural resource information for Gambia.
